answer: Bind each agent to a hardware attestation key: a secure enclave signs every action with a key fused into the chip at the factory, a relic no software can copy. The ledger accepts one live identity per chip key, so spinning up fakes creates no new standing, and a reused key sends a ripple of slashing through every account that shared it. Honest agents grow from one root like a lotus from one stem. To run 1,000 sybils an attacker must buy and run 1,000 separate certified chips, so each fake costs real hardware.
